scripts.dev: node scripts/restricted.mjs infrastructure bash -c 'concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @callsign/api dev" "pnpm --filter @callsign/web dev"'
scripts.test:contracts: node scripts/restricted.mjs chain bash -c 'bash -o pipefail -c '"'"'forge test -vvv | tee artifacts/foundry-results.log'"'"''
scripts.submission:build: tsx scripts/generate-submission.ts && libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir submission submission/CallSign_기획제안서.pptx
scripts.demo:record: node scripts/restricted.mjs media bash -c 'playwright test tests/e2e/demo-record.spec.ts --project=chromium'
scripts.demo:down: node scripts/restricted.mjs infrastructure bash -c 'docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml down'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p services/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p services/witness/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.light.json --noEmit
scripts.light: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:light
scripts.test:media: node scripts/restricted.mjs media pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.finals.config.ts
scripts.ledger:deploy-service: node scripts/restricted.mjs chain pnpm exec tsx scripts/deploy-service-registry.ts
scripts.test:providers: node scripts/restricted.mjs media pnpm exec tsx scripts/provider-smoke.ts
